text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... hah—!

During training—
Lately, our regimen has focused primarily on speed and stamina retention.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Phew.
...How was my speed?
choice_data_list: Solid and steady. The time looks great too!

text_block_list.text:
I had her run the final three furlongs near top speed...
Her pace remained consistent right to the goal, and her lap splits look good.
It might even be time to start pushing for top speed earlier, but...
choice_data_list: How did it feel to you?
How did it feel to you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I think I can hold the pace even if we push the timing earlier.
Though it'll be close to the limit.

In that case... rather than forcing more top-end speed, shifting focus
toward explosive acceleration would be better. Let's make a slight adjustment to the menu.
choice_data_list: Let me know anything you notice as we go.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Are we still doing the slope course next today, as planned?

She coordinates closely on training details like this.
Clear proof that she accepts me as a genuine partner in "work."
However...

After training.
Whenever I think to chat a bit and offer some words of encouragement—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today.
—Good work, Trainer.

...Believe departs briskly, leaving me watching her walk away
without exchanging even a moment of small talk. It's been like this every single day.

She trusts me as a partner on the "job." There's no doubt about that.
Yet... our relationship remains thoroughly, strictly business.

As her Trainer, shouldn't I be trying harder to break the ice with her...?
While wrestling with the thought, I happened to glance out the window—

For some reason, Believe was outside.
I was sure she'd gone straight back to the dorms after training...

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: Believe, what are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Repairing the flower bed.
I was asked to do so.

Looking closer, I saw that a section of the brick edging had indeed crumbled.
Fixing this all alone looked like it would take quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, that's unnecessary.
This is my job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I will finish before the sun sets completely.
Therefore, there is no issue.
choice_data_list: Still, it's tough on your own, right? Let me do something—
Still, it's tough on your own, right? Let me do something—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Unnecessary. I have sufficient hands.

...Pushing the matter any further won't get her to let me help.
Telling myself to respect her stance, I silently kept watch over her.
(*scrape, scrape—clack, clack...*)

Only the methodical sound of brickwork echoed across the yard.
As I watched without being able to do anything—

—The sun dipped below the horizon, and dusk began to fall.
Between post-training cooldowns, laundry, and dinner, she must have plenty of things to take care of herself.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—That should do it.
......

True to her word, it seemed she'd managed
to wrap up the repairs right on schedule.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I am returning to the dorms.
Thank you for your work today.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, get some good rest—

text_block_list.text:
Watching Believe walk away, I pondered the meaning
behind the quiet sigh she had just let slip.

Did offering to help and hovering by her side
actually just get in her way...?
choice_data_list: (I need to respect her work more.)
(I need to respect her work more.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The seam between the bricks still stands out too much...
Was it a lack of materials after all...? No, there must have been a better way...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......I'll rest for now.
—Rest, huh...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer looked so uncomfortable.
Maybe... my tone was too cold after all.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......I need to be more careful.
